rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges image softness, but it overstates confidence in visible ICM/TE detail from this low-clarity image and loosely equates stage 3 with expanded blastocyst.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, prior IVF failure, BMI, semen parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, especially around morphology versus age-related aneuploidy risk; only minor imprecision in morphology/staging language.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines, including SET for a good Day-5 blastocyst and cautious discussion of PGT-A; minor overreach in some adjunctive suggestions but no major guideline conflict.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than tightly protocol-specific.
